payload.title: Working with `Pandas`
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim for handling paleoclimate data. It covers exporting Pyleoclim Series to Pandas Series, unit conversions, time series selection, CSV import/export, and resampling. The notebook also explores handling MultipleSeries objects with Pandas, including exporting to DataFrames and aligning data to a common time axis.
